title: Quorum sensing (spec example)
selection: Bacterial quorum sensing: cells release a signal molecule and switch behaviour once its concentration crosses a threshold.

title: Vaswani et al. 2017 — attention
selection: Attention is a mechanism that computes a weighted average of values, where the weights are derived from the compatibility of a query with a set of keys.

title: Granovetter 1973 — weak ties
selection: Weak ties, often denounced as generative of alienation, are indispensable to individuals' opportunities and to their integration into communities; strong ties lead to overall fragmentation.

title: Kahneman & Tversky 1979 — prospect theory
selection: People evaluate outcomes as gains or losses relative to a reference point, are risk-averse over gains, risk-seeking over losses, and overweight small probabilities while underweighting large ones.

title: Lotka–Volterra predator–prey
selection: Prey grow exponentially in the absence of predators while predators decline without prey; encounters convert prey into new predators, producing coupled oscillations.

title: Shannon 1948 — noisy channel
selection: A message is encoded with redundancy so that, even when the channel corrupts some symbols, the receiver can recover the original with arbitrarily small error by exploiting the structure of the code.
